notes.title: Night Shift — We Are OPEN NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Night Shift is OPEN for 24/7![/h1]

[h3]Cyber752 Games and Indie.io proudly present a pizza horror, Night Shift.[/h3]
Night Shift Is Now Open for Business on Steam

[previewyoutube=Ol7Zh9rZofs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🔦 Key Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] 📼 [b]Survive Three Chilling Nights in a Cursed Pizza Parlor:[/b] You’ve accepted the night shift, now endure it. Finish your duties, if the rules don’t change first.
[*] 🕹️ [b]Retro PS1-Style Graphics, Authentic Horror Vibes:[/b] Experience the eerie aesthetic of classic survival horror.
[*] 🧠 [b]Psychological Terror with a Heavy Atmosphere:[/b] Uncover a twisted narrative built on dread, paranoia, and creeping unease.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602430/Night_Shift/

[b][h3]You're support means the world!
[/h3][/b]As a small indie team, your support means the world to us. Here's how you can help:

[list]
[*] If you buy the game, [b]please consider leaving an honest review on Steam![/b]  
Reviews have a massive impact on indie games, and we'd love to hear what you think (and what scared you most 👀).
[*] Share the game with your horror-loving friends or post your reactions on social media.
[*] Join our growing horror community for behind-the-scenes peeks, theories, and future updates:  
[url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url]
[*] Follow for developer insights, updates, and analog horror content:  
[url="https://x.com/Cyber752Games"]🐦 Follow the Developer[/url]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Play Night Shift on Steam![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602430/Night_Shift/


Happy Night Shift,
[b]Cyber752 Games[/b]
